rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an is revealed to you from God through His knowledge and wisdom.
rows.anchor: أي يلقى إليك القرآن وحيا من عند الله أنزله بعلمه وحكمته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: إذ is accusative; recall Moses speaking to his family, that is, recall his story.
rows.anchor: المعنى اذكر إذ قال موسى لأهله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: آنست نارا means Moses saw a fire.
rows.anchor: ومعنى آنست نارا رأيت نارا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: قبس is read with tanwin or in annexation; with tanwin it describes شهاب, since every luminous white thing is a flame.
rows.anchor: وكل أبيض ذي نور فهو شهاب

rows.speaker: التفسير
rows.claim: Exegetical reports say they were in winter and needed the fire to warm themselves.
rows.anchor: جاء في التفسير أنهم كانوا في شتاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أن may be accusative with an implicit passive subject in نودي, or nominative as the passive subject itself.
rows.anchor: إن شئت كان نصبا وإن شئت كان رفعا

rows.speaker: التفسير
rows.claim: The exegetical explanation identifies the one in the fire as God's light.
rows.anchor: أن (من في النار) ههنا نور الله

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Those around the fire are identified as angels or as God's light.
rows.anchor: قيل الملائكة وقيل نور الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: سبحان الله means declaring God exalted above evil; this is attributed to the Prophet and language scholars.
rows.anchor: معناه تنزيه الله تبارك وتعالى عن السوء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The serpent moved with a jinn's light, quick motion though it had the shape of a great snake.
rows.anchor: تتحرك كما يتحرك الجان حركة خفيفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The الثعبان is the great kind of snake.
rows.anchor: وهو؛ العظيم من الحيات

rows.speaker: التفسير
rows.claim: Exegetical reports explain لم يعقب as Moses not looking back.
rows.anchor: جاء في التفسير " لم يعقب " لم يلتفت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Linguists explain it as not returning; عقب can mean returning to fight after retreat.
rows.anchor: قد عقب فلان إذا رجع يقاتل بعد أن ولى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Labid's verse uses المعقب to witness the sense of returning after retreat.
rows.anchor: قال لبيد: حتى تهجر في الرواح وهاجه. . . طلب المعقب حقه المظلوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: لدي means عندي, at My presence.
rows.anchor: معناه لا يخاف عندي المرسلون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: إلا is a disconnected exception, not an exception from the preceding class.
rows.anchor: استثناء ليس من الأول، والمعنى، والله أعلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exception means anyone among the messengers or others who sins, then repents and replaces evil with good is forgiven.
rows.anchor: لكن من ظلم ثم تاب من المرسلين وغيرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The queen means kings ruin towns by entering in force, through fighting and conquest.
rows.anchor: معناه إذا دخلوها عنوة عن قتال وغلبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This is God's comment in the preferred reading; repeating the queen's report that kings ruin towns adds nothing.
rows.anchor: من قول الله عز وجل

rows.speaker: التفسير
rows.claim: Exegetical reports say the queen sent a gold brick, or gold bricks, wrapped in silk.
rows.anchor: جاء في التفسير أنها أهدت سليمان لبنة ذهب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One account says Solomon put a gold brick where animals urinated and defecated, making the visitors' gift seem small.
rows.anchor: فأمر سليمان بلبنة ذهب فطرحت تحت الدواب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although other gift accounts are reported, Solomon's question about wealth indicates the gift was money.
rows.anchor: مما يدل على أن الهدية كانت مالا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After a preposition, interrogative ما loses its alif to distinguish a question; non-interrogative ما keeps it.
rows.anchor: في الاستفهام تحذف معها الألف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The arrival may be the queen's messenger or her gift; the next command addresses the messenger, favoring the first reading.
rows.anchor: معناه فلما جاء رسولها سليمان

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One view takes the revelation as God casting inspiration into Moses' mother's heart.
rows.anchor: قيل إن الوحي ههنا ألقاء الله في قلبها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The promise of Moses' return and prophethood makes direct divine communication assuring her the clearer reading; inspiration remains possible.
rows.anchor: أنه وحي من الله عز وجل على جهة الإعلام للضمان لها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wahy fundamentally means conveying information secretly; inspiration is called wahy for that reason.
rows.anchor: وأصل الوحى في اللغة كلها إعلام في خفي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-yamm means the sea.
rows.anchor: وقوله: (فألقيه في اليم) اليم البحر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase is also read with the alternative vocalization حَزَنًا alongside حُزْنًا.
rows.anchor: وحزنا) ويجوز (وحزنا)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The clause describes an outcome, not their intention; it is like acquiring wealth that leads to one's death.
rows.anchor: ليصير الأمر إلى ذلك لا أنهم طلبوه وأخذوه لهذا

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: A report identifies the man as a believer from Pharaoh's household and a carpenter.
rows.anchor: مؤمن آل فرعون، وإنه كان نجارا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: يسعى means he ran quickly.
rows.anchor: ومعنى يسعى يعدو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ملأ are nobles and prominent people whom others look to.
rows.anchor: الملأ أشراف القوم، والمنظور إليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: يأتمرون بك means they urge one another to kill Moses.
rows.anchor: ومعنى يأتمرون بك يأمر بعضهم بعضا بقتلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: لك is not governed by الناصحين, since a complement cannot precede its noun; it clarifies advice given for Moses' benefit.
rows.anchor: لأن الصلة لا تقدم على الموصول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The construction means advising for someone's benefit; نصحت لك is more common than نصحتك.
rows.anchor: إني من الناصحين ينصحون لك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses feared being caught and killed, and watched for signs or tracks.
rows.anchor: أي يرقمب أن يلحقه في يقتله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The oppressive people are Pharaoh's people.
rows.anchor: يعني من قوم فرعون

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Madyan was Shuayb's people's watering place, said to be eight days from Egypt, about the distance between Basra and Kufa.
rows.anchor: ماء كان لقوم شعيب يقال إن بينه وبين مصر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses took the road leading toward Madyan.
rows.anchor: سلك في الطريق التي تلقاء مدين فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: سبيل is a road; سواء السبيل means the straight, direct course.
rows.anchor: سواء السبيل قصد الطريق في الاستواء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Madyan is genitive but indeclinable because it is a place name.
rows.anchor: لكنه لا ينصرف لأنه اسم للبقعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أمة means a group of people.
rows.anchor: عليه أمة من الناس يسقون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The women kept their sheep from the water because stronger men at the watering place drove them away.
rows.anchor: عن الماء من هو على السقي أقوى منهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ما خطبكما asks their situation or purpose: what they intend by keeping their flock from the water.
rows.anchor: ما تريدان بذودكما غنمكما عن الماء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With yuṣdiru, shepherds make their flocks return after watering; with yaṣduru, the shepherds themselves return.
rows.anchor: بضم الياء وكسر الدال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: الرعاء is plural of راع, as صحاب is plural of صاحب.
rows.anchor: كما يقال صاحب وصحاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command means to make fired bricks; a report says Pharaoh was first to make bricks.
rows.anchor: ويقال إن فرعون أول من عمل الآجر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A ṣarḥ is a broad, lofty building.
rows.anchor: والصرح كل بناء متسع مرتفع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh thought his tower might reach the sky so he could see it and whatever was in it.
rows.anchor: وظن فرعون أنه يتهيأ له أن يبلغ بصرحه نحو السماء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ظن can denote doubt or certainty.
rows.anchor: الظن في اللغة ضرب يكون شكا ويقينا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh admits uncertainty: he rejected Moses without certainty he lied, though signs made him suspect Moses was a prophet.
rows.anchor: اعتراف بأنه شاو، وأنه لم يتيقن أن موسى كاذب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh's statement elsewhere that he knew God sent the signs proves decisive evidence had confronted him.
rows.anchor: لقد علمت ما أنزل هؤلاء إلا رب السماوات والأرض بصائر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The partners did not answer them with an argument.
rows.anchor: أي لم يجيبوهم بحجة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The response to لو is omitted: had they been guided, they would not have followed the partners or seen punishment.
rows.anchor: المعنى لو كانوا يهتدون لما اتبعوهم ولا رأوا العذاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The best pause is after ويختار, taking ما as negation: God creates and chooses, and people have no choice against Him.
rows.anchor: أجود الوقوف على (ويختار)؛ وتكون " ما " نفيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the preferred negative reading, people have no right to choose against God.
rows.anchor: أي ليس لهم أن يختاروا على الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, ما is relative: God chooses what benefits people in the worship He calls them to.
rows.anchor: في معنى الذي فيكون المعنى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God selects a prophet from every community, and each prophet witnesses against that community.
rows.anchor: أي نزعنا من كل أمة نبيا أي اخترنا منها نبيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are asked for evidence supporting their belief and proving they were right.
rows.anchor: أي هاتوا فيما اعتقدتم برهانا أي بيانا أنكم كنتم على حق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They learn that truth is God's oneness and what His prophets brought.
rows.anchor: أي فعلموا أن الحق توحيد الله وما جاء به أنبياؤه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their false objects of worship bring no benefit and instead harm them greatly.
rows.anchor: لم ينتفعوا بكل ما عبدوه من دون الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qarun is a foreign proper name and indeclinable; even an Arabic faʿul derivation would remain indeclinable, explaining no tanwin.
rows.anchor: قارون اسم أعجمي لا ينصرف

words: إِنَّ قَٰرُونَ كَانَ مِن قَوْمِ مُوسَىٰ
rows.speaker: التفسير
rows.claim: Reports call Qarun Moses' cousin and a Torah scholar; he opposed Moses and sought to discredit him.
rows.anchor: قارون كان ابن عم موسى

rows.speaker: التفسير
rows.claim: Qarun, then richest man, hired a notorious woman to falsely accuse Moses of soliciting her, promising marriage and payment.
rows.anchor: يأمرها أن تصير إليه، وهو في ملأ من أصحابه

rows.speaker: التفسير
rows.claim: The woman repented and exposed Qarun; he was stunned, and God gave Moses authority over him and ordered earth to obey him.
rows.anchor: ورزقها الله التوبة

rows.speaker: التفسير
rows.claim: Moses ordered earth to swallow Qarun and his house in stages, from knees to navel to neck, until both sank.
rows.anchor: فخسف به وبداره إلى ركبتيه

rows.speaker: رواية
rows.claim: A report describes Qarun's keys as finger-sized leather pieces carried by seventy or sixty mules.
rows.anchor: روي في التفسير أن مفاتحه كانت من جلود على مقادر الإصبع

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another interpretation takes مفاتحه to mean his storehouses or treasuries.
rows.anchor: وجاء أيضا أن مفاتحه خزائنه

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: The group is variously said to number seventy, forty, fifteen to forty, or three to ten.
rows.anchor: وقيل إن العصبة ههنا سبعون رجلا، وقيل أربعون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: عصبة is a common-purpose group whose members follow and support one another.
rows.anchor: والعصبة في اللغة الجماعة الذين أمرهم واحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The likelier reading is keys meaning treasuries of wealth carried on seventy or forty mules; tiny leather keys could not be so burdensome.
rows.anchor: أن مفاتحه خزائنه، وأنها خزائن المال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase means the keys or treasuries weighed heavily on the group.
rows.anchor: ومعنى (لتنوء بالعصبة) لتثقل العصبة

rows.speaker: أبو زيد
rows.claim: Abu Zayd says نؤت بالحمل means I rose carrying a load, while ناء بي الحمل means the load weighed me down.
rows.anchor: قال أبو زيد: يقال نؤت بالحمل أنوء به نوءا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ṭūfān is abundant harm surrounding a whole group, such as a flood over cities; devastating slaughter and sweeping death are also called ṭūfān.
rows.anchor: الطوفان من كل شيء ما كان كثيرا مطيفا بالجماعة كلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elsewhere the ship's passengers are described as each pair, Noah's family except the condemned, and believers.
rows.anchor: قد بين في غير هذه الآية من أصحاب السفينة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sense is We sent Abraham, conjoined with Noah's account.
rows.anchor: المعنى وأرسلنا إبراهيم عطفا على نوح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A recitation is reported with the form وَتَخْلُقُونَ إِفْكًا.
rows.anchor: من دون الله أوثانا وتخلقون إفكا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أوثانا means idols.
rows.anchor: أوثانا أصناما. وتخلقون إفكا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One explanation is that they invent lies.
rows.anchor: وتخلقون إفكا فيه قولان: تخلقون كذبا

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another explanation is that they manufacture the idols they worship.
rows.anchor: وقيل تعملون الأصنام، ويكون التأويل على هذا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wording is formally a question but functions as assertion and rebuke.
rows.anchor: اللفظ لفظ استفهام، والمعنى معنى التقرير والتوبيخ

rows.speaker: التفسير
rows.claim: One view says they obstructed the path of offspring; another says they intercepted travelers for sexual immorality.
rows.anchor: جاء في التفسير ويقطعون سبيل الولد

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One report says they pelted and mocked people in gatherings; God calls this wrongdoing and forbids socializing around mockery.
rows.anchor: قيل إنهم كانوا يخذفون الناس في مجالسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People should gather for what brings them nearer to God and farther from His displeasure, not mockery or amusement.
rows.anchor: ولا يجتمعوا إلا فيما قرب إلى الله

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view is that they committed sexual immorality in their gatherings.
rows.anchor: أنهم كانوا يفسقون في مجالسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One reading of أكبر takes it to mean كبير, great.
rows.anchor: أن أكبر في معنى كبير

rows.speaker: التفسير
rows.claim: An exegetical explanation says God's remembrance of you is greater than your remembrance of Him.
rows.anchor: ولذكر الله إياكم إذا ذكرتموه أكبر من ذكركم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view says God's prohibition of indecency and wrongdoing is greater than merely refraining from those acts.
rows.anchor: النهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر، أكبر من الانتهاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exception means people at war: discuss with protected scriptural communities politely, but fight those who wrong you.
rows.anchor: لا تجادلوا أهل الجزية إلا بالتي هي أحسن

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Some say this was abrogated by the jizya command because subjection is not the best manner; the author finds abrogation likelier.
rows.anchor: فالأشبه أن تكون منسوخة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, taking jizya from them even unwillingly may be the humiliation meant, leaving the verse applicable.
rows.anchor: وجائز أن يكون الصغار أخذ الجزية منهم وإن كرهوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jews and Christians are named for jizya because they possess Torah and Gospel; Magians are included through a prophetic instruction.
rows.anchor: فالذين تؤخذ منهم الجزية بنص الكتاب

rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: The Prophet said to treat the Magians according to the practice for the People of the Book.
rows.anchor: سنوا بهم سئة أهل الكتاب

rows.speaker: مالك بن أنس
rows.claim: Malik holds that jizya is accepted from other polytheists and similar non-Muslims, Arab or non-Arab.
rows.anchor: فهم عند مالك بن أنس يجرون هذا المجرى

rows.speaker: أهل العراق
rows.claim: Iraqi jurists accept jizya from non-Arab unbelievers beyond the three scriptural groups, but not from other Arabs.
rows.anchor: وأما أهل العراق فقالوا نقبل الجزية من العجم غير العرب

rows.speaker: بعض الفقهاء
rows.claim: Some jurists permit only fighting idolaters and similar groups.
rows.anchor: وبعض الفقهاء لا يرى إلا القتل في عبدة

words: وَإِن جَٰهَدَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تُشْرِكَ بِى
rows.speaker: سعد بن أبي وقاص
rows.claim: Saʿd said the verse concerned him: his mother starved herself three days to force apostasy, was fed after her mouth was forced open, and he vowed not to recant even if she had seventy souls.
rows.anchor: سعد بن أبي وقاص ذكر أن هذه الآية نزلت بسببه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: صاحبته has verbal-noun forms مصاحبا and مصاحبة.
rows.anchor: وقوله عز وجل: (وصاحبهما في الدنيا معروفا)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: معروف means actions considered good.
rows.anchor: ومعنى المعروف ما يستحسن من الأفعال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Follow the path of the one who has returned to God.
rows.anchor: أي اتبع سبيل من رجع إلي

words: إِنَّهَآ إِن تَكُ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍۢ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍۢ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God will bring forth even a mustard seed's weight wherever hidden, including a rock or the depths of the sea, because He knows its location.
rows.anchor: لطيف في استخراجها خبير بمكانها

rows.speaker: رواية
rows.claim: Luqman's son asks whether God knows of a seed in the sea's depths; Luqman explains God knows it in the most hidden place.
rows.anchor: ويروى أن ابن لقمان سأل لقمان فقال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مقل يمقل means to dive; a seed inside rock is more hidden than one in water, yet God knows it.
rows.anchor: يقال مقل يمقل إذا غاص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The seed exemplifies human deeds God brings forth on Judgment Day, like the verses about an atom's weight of good or evil.
rows.anchor: فمن يعمل مثقال ذرة خيرا يره (7) ومن يعمل مثقال ذرة شرا يره (8)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nominative مثقال can accompany feminine تك because it refers in sense to feminine خردلة, as in إن تك حبة.
rows.anchor: راجع إلى معنى خردلة، فهو بمنزلة إن تك حبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Accusative مثقال can refer to the object asked about or a deed, however small; إنها may refer to the whole matter.
rows.anchor: على معنى أن التي سألتني عنها إن تك مثقال حبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The words of God do not end or run out.
rows.anchor: كلمات الله). معناه ما انقطعت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The explanation answers polytheists who claimed the Qur'an's speech would run out: God's words and wisdom are inexhaustible.
rows.anchor: قالوا في القرآن: إن هذا كلام سينفد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creating or resurrecting all people is like creating or resurrecting one person; God's power over the whole equals His power over one.
rows.anchor: أي قدرة الله على بعث الخلق أجمعين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Inserting night into day refers to summer nights extending into daytime.
rows.anchor: ليل الصيف في نهاره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Inserting day into night refers to winter days extending into nighttime.
rows.anchor: يدخل نهار الشتاء في ليله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: يتوفاكم derives from completing a count: the angel takes every soul, like collecting all money owed.
rows.anchor: أنه يقبض أرواحكم أجمعين فلا ينقص واحد منكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The conditional has no stated answer; the Prophet is addressed for humankind, as in plural-address wording elsewhere, with an implied lesson to see.
rows.anchor: يا أيها النبي إذا طلقتم النساء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase has an implicit يقولون: they say, before ربنا أبصرنا.
rows.anchor: فيه إضمار " يقولون ربنا أبصرنا

words: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَءَاتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدَىٰهَا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The meaning parallels the statement that God could have gathered everyone upon guidance.
rows.anchor: ولو شاء الله لجمعهم على الهدى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase is also compared with necks humbled before a sign.
rows.anchor: فظلت أعناقهم لها خاضعين

words: أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقًا
rows.speaker: التفسير
rows.claim: Reports say the verse concerns Ali ibn Abi Talib, believer, and Uqba ibn Abi Muayt, sinner; the next promise testifies Ali is a believer and in Paradise.
rows.anchor: جاء في التفسير أنها نزلت في علي بن أبي طالب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The plural fits because من is singular in form but can denote one person or a group, meaning believers and unbelievers are unequal.
rows.anchor: ولكن " من " لفظها لفظ الواحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The plural can refer to two because two form a group; a dual لا يستويان would also be valid.
rows.anchor: لأن معنى الاثنين جماعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The lower punishment is worldly and the greater punishment belongs to the afterlife.
rows.anchor: الأدنى ما يصيبهم في الدنيا

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One view is worldly hardship through drought and fear, supported by the verse on trials of fear, hunger, and loss.
rows.anchor: فقيل: ما يصيبهم من الجدب والخوف

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view identifies it as captivity and killing; generally it includes all punishment in this world.
rows.anchor: وجملته أن كل ما يعذب به في الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person called one's son by adoption is not one's son in reality.
rows.anchor: من تدعونه ابنا وليس بولد في الحقيقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Inheritance had been based on migration, excluding a non-migrant despite kinship; God restored close relatives' priority and ended inheritance based on migration.
rows.anchor: يتوارثون على الهجرة ولا يرث الأعرابي من المهاجر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Adopting false lineage is only a spoken claim, with no reality beneath it.
rows.anchor: قول بالفم لا حقيقة معنى تحته

words: وَٱللَّهُ يَقُولُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَهُوَ يَهْدِى ٱلسَّبِيلَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God does not make a non-son into a son; His guidance is straight, as in فقد ضل سواء السبيل.
rows.anchor: مثل قوله: (فقد ضل سواء السبيل)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أقسط means more just.
rows.anchor: هو أقسط عند الله) أي هو أعدل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If a person's father is unknown, treat him as a brother in religion if he believes, and call him brother.
rows.anchor: فهو أخوك في الدين إذا كان مؤمنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مواليكم may mean paternal cousins or allies in religion.
rows.anchor: بنو عمكم، ويجوز أن يكون: ومواليكم

words: وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌۭ فِيمَآ أَخْطَأْتُم بِهِۦ وَلَٰكِن مَّا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One analysis excuses mistakes before the rule and assigns sin to deliberate acts; ما is genitive and coordinated with the earlier ما.
rows.anchor: قبل أن تنهوا عن هذا، ولكن ما تعمدت قلوبكم

words: وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌۭ فِيمَآ أَخْطَأْتُم بِهِۦ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first ما is governed by في; on this analysis the next ما coordinates with it, contrasting mistakes and deliberate acts.
rows.anchor: عطف على (ما) الأولى المعنى: وليس عليكم جناح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, calling someone son is not blameworthy unless one intends to treat him as a child for inheritance.
rows.anchor: ولا جناح عليكم في أن تقولوا له با بني
